name: v2-feed-override
review: Four 20 mm Cartesian axis moves produce 1600 steps each and end at zero. At 100 mm/s^2 acceleration and the firmware's default 0.05 mm junction deviation, 90-degree junction speed is about 3.474 mm/s. Applying feed limits of 50, 25, 100 and 50 mm/s to continuous trapezoidal or triangular profiles gives durations 0.86104, 0.98535, 0.82764 and 0.86104 s; recorded durations are 0.86086, 0.98526, 0.82750 and 0.85760 s, differing by at most 0.40%. The 50% segment reaches its 25 mm/s cap; the 200% segment is acceleration-limited, so this case does not establish its maximum possible speed. Two simulator runs produced identical traces; discrete pulses and physical timing remain unverified.
